span.p:
Key Rules:
1. Higher = evaluated first
2. Same level = left-to-right (except unary, assignment, conditional = right-to-left)
3. Use parentheses () to override
4. When in doubt: ADD PARENS!

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Examples:
a + b * c → a + (b * c) not (a + b) * c
a << 1 + 2 → a << (1 + 2) not (a << 1) + 2
*p++ → *(p++) not (*p)++
a = b = c → a = (b = c) right-to-left
